source.name: Chapter 6: 1.3 Test Your Knowledge - MCP Server
source.instructions: What does the MCP server expose to the sub-agent's LLM?

answers.answer: Callable functions, called tools, that the LLM can invoke during its reasoning loop
A copy of the conversation history from the main agent
The Rasa flow definitions the sub-agent can call

source.learningObjectives: SWBAT what the MCP server exposes in a sub-agent
source.guidance: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard for exposing callable functions to an LLM. The sub-agent's LLM discovers what tools are available, calls them during the ReAct loop, and processes their results to decide what to do next.
